weekend_summary: Lewis Hamilton took pole in Mexico City, with George Russell alongside. Max Verstappen won the Grand Prix ahead of Hamilton and Antonelli. Antonelli finished P3 to seal the 2026 drivers championship. The race featured a red flag following Bottas' heavy accident and a late Safety Car after Lindblad crashed. Haas fielded Ryo Hirakawa for qualifying and the Grand Prix in place of Esteban Ocon.

Q.summary: Hamilton claimed Mexico pole, ahead of Russell. Lawson was later disqualified from qualifying for a technical MGU-K power-rule breach, distinct from the underlying timed-lap pace.

key_moments.text: Hamilton claimed Mexico pole, ahead of Russell. Lawson was later disqualified from qualifying for a technical MGU-K power-rule breach, distinct from the underlying timed-lap pace.

R.summary: Verstappen won from Hamilton and Antonelli in a race affected by Bottas' red flag and a late Safety Car.

strategy_and_conditions.text: Mexico Q and R were run in broadly dry conditions; interruptions and penalties affect final classification but do not by themselves make the session uniformly wet.
Haas substitution: Ryo Hirakawa (HIR) drove car 50 in Q/R; Ocon was not a Mexico Q/R entrant. The frozen October 29 V1 forecast predated the substitution, so only overlapping drivers are scored.
Lawson disqualification followed a qualifying MGU-K power-rule infringement. He subsequently started from the pit lane; compare qualifying pace separately from classification.
Bottas received a 50-place PU penalty; Verstappen a one-place drop following the FP2 Lawson clash.

grid_penalty_context.text: BOT: 50-place PU drop; start from back. Five new PU elements beyond allowance; documented Oct 30 and final Mexico grid.
VER: One-place grid drop. Collision with Lawson during Mexico FP2; final grid P5.

LAW: One-place drop; Q disqualification; pit-lane start. FP2 collision with Verstappen; qualifying MGU-K power-rule disqualification; subsequent parc-ferme setup/PU changes resulted in pit-lane start. Distinguish qualifying performance from grid classification.
